author: Conrad von Baldenstein, 1827
status: 겨울에 드물게 찾아옴, 지금까지 기록 10건 미만 · 2000년 이후 확인된 기록 없음
summary: 겨울에 드물게 찾아오는 새로, 지금까지 국내 기록이 10건이 안 되고 2000년 이후로는 확인된 기록이 없다. 쇠박새와 매우 닮아 야외에서 생김새로 가려내기는 어렵지만 울음소리로 구별할 수 있고, 표본으로는 발가락 길이와 부리 모양으로 쉽게 가린다. 한국, 시베리아, 중국 북부, 일본에 분포한다.

points.en: deep black cap, sometimes tinged brown

similar.how: 정수리가 더 짙은 검은색이고 때로 갈색을 띠며, 둘째날개깃에 보통 담색 반점이 있다. 야외에서는 울음소리로, 표본에서는 발가락 길이와 부리 모양으로 구별한다.

art.subject: Willow Tit (Poecile montanus), adult (sexes alike) in winter: dull sooty-black cap without gloss, extending well down onto the nape, sometimes faintly tinged brown; large white cheeks reaching back to the sides of the neck; a fairly large black bib below the bill. Back, wings and tail plain ash grey-brown, with pale fringes to the secondaries forming a whitish panel on the closed wing. Underparts whitish with a faint buff wash on the flanks. Short black bill; dark eye; dark grey legs.
art.pose: perched on a twig, side view
art.scene: Korean winter mixed forest of birch, larch and pine on a northern mountain slope, light snow on the branches; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view perched on a twig: dull sooty-black cap reaching down the nape, large white cheeks, black bib, plain grey-brown upperparts with a whitish panel on the secondaries, whitish underparts with buff flanks
adult, head detail: matt black cap without gloss, faintly tinged brown, large white cheek patch, black bib, short black bill
art.build: Small tit, 12.5cm, slightly smaller than a sparrow; compact with a relatively large head and a thick-looking 'bull' neck. Bill short, thin and pointed, much shorter than the head. Legs fairly short, dark grey. Wings short and rounded; tail of medium length with a slightly rounded tip. Restless, hopping and hanging among twigs.
avoid: Do not paint a glossy blue-black cap or a small neat bib; those mark the Marsh Tit (Poecile palustris).
Do not add a white nape patch or two white wing bars (Coal Tit).
Do not give it yellow, green or blue tones, or a black stripe down the belly (Japanese Tit and other tits).
